Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
        

          September 29, 2026
        
Ollama now supports decision models, based on TypeSafe's Jev API for fast, typed decisions. Decision models can now be run at no cost with low latency. Based on text, decision models answer yes-or-no questions, choices and scores about it, with a probability for every option.

Ollama's transparent pricing
        

          August 31, 2026
        
Ollama's Pro, Max, and Team plans now use industry-standard per-token pricing with usage included on every plan.

Claude Desktop support with Ollama
        

          August 25, 2026
        
Claude Desktop can now be configured to work with Ollama as a third-party gateway provider, making it possible to use open models in Claude.
